headings.instructions: Use Outfit for all English headers. Use Tajawal or Cairo for Arabic headers (add via Google Fonts). Maintain tight tracking (tracking-tight) for headers above 32px.

body.instructions: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for English body text, Tajawal for Arabic. Standard line-height (leading-relaxed).

primary.description: Deep Indigo for primary actions and CTA buttons to create a bold, confident feel.

secondary.description: Mint/Cyan accent for highlights, hover states, and 'Upload/Success' states.

background.description: Clean white theme. Ensure strong contrast.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm) for dashboard cards and slightly elevated shadows (shadow-lg, shadow-indigo-500/20) for primary CTA buttons.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB for cards. Split-view should have a definitive central border.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for inputs, rounded-full for pill buttons.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons. Drag and Drop zone should highlight (bg-indigo-50/50, border-indigo-500) when dragging over. Split-view document fields highlight both the bounding box on the image and the input field on hover.

layouts.bilingual: Full RTL support. Use logical Tailwind CSS properties (e.g., ms-*, me-*, ps-*, pe-*) instead of physical (ml-*, mr-*) to ensure seamless switching between Arabic and English. Apply dir='rtl' to the HTML/body when Arabic is selected.
layouts.landing_page: Bento grid or Tetris grid for features. Massive centered bold text for Hero. Clear nav with Language Toggle.
layouts.dashboard: Sidebar on the start edge (left for LTR, right for RTL). Main content area with a max-width for readability.
layouts.split_view: h-[calc(100vh-theme(spacing.16))] layout. 50/50 split. Left side: Scrollable document viewer. Right side: Scrollable form list.

components_instructions.UploadZone: Prominent, dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300), centered icon, subtle background tint.
components_instructions.SplitViewEditor: Use sticky headers for the document title. Use a visual 'bounding box' overlay on the document image that maps to form fields.
components_instructions.ConfidenceScore: Small pill badges next to inputs. Red (<50%), Yellow (50-80%), Green (>80%).
components_instructions.TemplatePicker: Grid of 4 cards (Invoice, Receipt, PO, ID) with subtle icons.

motion.transitions: Add smooth transitions to hover states (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-in for dashboard list items and landing page feature cards.

accessibility.keyboard: CRITICAL for Split-View Editor: Must support Tab to move between fields and Enter to confirm.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over brand colors meets APCA standards.
accessibility.data_testid: Apply data-testid to ALL interactive elements (e.g., login-button, upload-dropzone, field-invoice-total, review-submit-btn, lang-toggle).

image_urls.description: Dashboard analytics mockup for landing page graphics

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You have .js files not .tsx files, so write valid React JavaScript (.jsx/.js) syntax.
Do not center-align the app container. Use proper layout containers.
Do not use generic 'transition: all'. Target specific properties.
Use Phosphor icons, Lucide React, or react-icons for UI elements and logos (e.g., FaGoogle for login). Do not use placeholders for logos.
Support dynamic RTL: When switching language to Arabic, set dir='rtl' on HTML or main wrapper, and ensure all padding/margins use logical properties (ps-4 instead of pl-4).
The UI should feel like a high-end tool (Linear/Notion) - meaning tight spacing, crisp 1px borders, muted secondary text, and focus on content.
DO NOT use teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Stick to Indigo and Cyan/Mint.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns to ensure legibility.
